name: node_cpu_busy_anomaly
title: Fleet CPU busy share is unusually high
description: Fleet-wide CPU busy share (1 minus the mean idle share across all cores and nodes, from system_cpu_utilization) is above its learned weekday/weekend hour-of-day band in at least 2 of the last 3 five-minute buckets. Unit: ratio 0-1. An unusual-jump signal only; the static node_high_cpu_utilization alert stays primary. Whole fleet; add AND k8s_cluster = '...' or a k8s_node_name condition to the WHERE clause after install for a per-entity alert (one config per entity).

anomaly_config.custom_sql: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5m') AS time_bucket, 1 - AVG(value) AS cpu_busy FROM "system_cpu_utilization" WHERE state = 'idle' GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket
